canonical_project: Supernode Brendale hyperscale data centre campus
owner: Quinbrook Infrastructure Partners / Supernode Pty Ltd
notes: Quinbrook's Supernode page describes a Brendale integrated digital-and-energy campus with hyperscale data centre halls, 500 MW-IT potential on-site capacity and up to 2GW-IT precinct capability; construction to date is focused on BESS stages, with additional hyperscale data-centre development planned. Moreton Bay/Queensland sources state council planning and FIRB approval for the Brendale complex; DCD reports the 30-hectare Moreton Bay site is intended for four hyperscale data centers.
